title: Company OKR Synthesis Kit: initiative staging, cadence signals, and conflict-resolution rules
creator: Aisha K. Morales
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, reusable kit that product, engineering, design, and GTM teams can use to stage company-level OKRs into executable initiatives with clear owners, conflict-resolution rules, and cadence signals.

Scope: The kit will include (1) initiative staging templates, (2) a decision and escalation runway for competing resource claims, (3) cadence signal definitions (when an initiative is green/at-risk/blocked), (4) a measurable success rubric and telemetry checklist, and (5) a short training slide deck and Confluence playbook for onboarding.

Why now: We have repeated friction during company-wide planning where teams interpret objective boundaries differently, leading to duplicated work or uncoordinated rollout sequencing. This creates downstream cost and slows delivery for Dedicated/Private launch lanes. The kit aims to reduce alignment cycles and improve predictability for cross-org milestones.

Success metrics: Reduce cross-team alignment meetings by 30% for company OKR planning; decrease initiative handoff delays between PM->ENG by 25% (tracked in Linear); and surface dependency conflicts earlier (median detection moved earlier by at least one sprint).

Deliverables: Confluence playbook, initiative staging template (Google Sheet + downloadable CSV), example RACI for two common cases (feature-led product, infra-led reliability), a short training deck, and a monitoring dashboard spec (Console view) that shows initiative health signals and blocking items.

Assumptions and trade-offs: We will prioritize clarity and low friction over exhaustive process. The kit will not attempt to replace team-specific delivery rituals (e.g., SCRUM boards) and will be intentionally lightweight. We accept some manual steps initially (annotations in Linear) to iterate on real-world behavior before automating flows in Redwood Console.
acceptance_criteria: Confluence playbook published and linked from Company Strategy page
Initiative staging template completed and validated with 3 cross-functional pilots (ENG, PM, Design)
Conflict-resolution runway documented with two example escalation paths and a named escalation owner roster
Cadence signals (green/yellow/red) defined with instrumentation guide and mock Console tiles
Training deck created and 30-minute onboarding session scheduled for Q2 planning sync
decisions: Use a 3-tier cadence signal (green/yellow/red) with automated checks for schedule slippage and dependency count
Keep the initial RACI limited to Owner / Lead / Support to reduce overhead
Escalation runway will route to Strategy lead -> PM Director -> CTO for high-impact cross-org conflicts
Instrument initiative health with 3 telemetry signals: % milestones on-track, open blocking dependencies, and change in estimated effort
